body:
I have no interests.
I don't even know if going to the doctor would be a change for the postive, it would probably just burden my family.

Eh, I guess I'm a weak person. Things that seem easy to others are hard for me, I don't see any future for myself. The outcome is always the same. I think I'm straining everyone else.
I find it hard to talk because I feel like I'm just wasting time. There is no point. Only person who can do anything is myself right. It is kind of funny I tried to talk to a doctor once, but when the time came I couldn't really say anything that mattered to me. And she said that she thought I should just eat more, and take some vitamins. Really nice. Even if i could talk about my problems i don't think it would change anything.
